title: LeBron joins 76ers to chase one more NBA title at age 41
summary: LeBron James, yearning to capture a fifth career NBA title, tips off his record 24th campaign on Tuesday at age 41 with his new Philadelphia 76ers teammates chasing a long-sought crown.
